
To check whether a string begins with a '''cmavo''', first you have to check that it does not begin with a [[jbocre: Morphology: c|cmene]] or with a '''CVCy-lujvo'''.

A '''CVCy-lujvo''' consists of a [[jbocre: Morphology: rafsi VC-rafsi]], then a [[jbocre: Morphology: vowels]], then any number of [[jbocre: Morphology: rafsi nitial-rafsi]] (possibly none) and finally a [[jbocre: Morphology: brivla rivla-core]].

If the string does not begin with a [[jbocre: Morphology: c|cmene]] or with a '''CVCy-lujvo''', then it begins with a '''cmavo''' if it begins with a '''cmavo-form''' and is followed by a [[jbocre: Morphology: special characters ause]] or by a [[jbocre: Morphology: words ojban-word]]. 

A '''cmavo-form''' consists of a non-[[jbocre: Morphology: consonants]], non-[[jbocre: Morphology: consonants luster]] [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables nset]], any number of [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables ucleus]] (possibly none), and a final [[jbocre: Morphology: vowels ucleus]] which is not [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables tressed]] or, if [[jbocre: Morphology: syllables tressed]], it is not followed by a [[jbocre: Morphology: consonants luster]]. A '''cmavo-form''' can also consist of one or more [[jbocre: Morphology: vowels]]'s in a row, or of a [[jbocre: Morphology: special characters igit]].
